pos.personaBrief: Cruyff: 'you have what the opposition don't, and therefore they can't score'; possession, mobility and moving the ball were the trademarks (Coaches' Voice, FourFourTwo). Ball is defence and control, never ceded for counters.

pro.personaBrief: Keeper and defenders in build-up, short play out even under a high press, ball moved and moved to create imbalances; but long switches from Koeman and Zubizarreta as an outlet existed.

est.personaBrief: Positional football by triangles, close passing lines, rondos, false nine dropping to combine, a defined 3-4-3 structure with set roles.

lar.personaBrief: Numerical superiority in midfield and close passing lines, but two out-and-out wingers and full-backs widening the pitch (Coaches' Voice); wingers also moved inside.

blo.personaBrief: Compact block high up the pitch, defender pushed forward, regain in the opposition half; strikers and short players pressed 'like rats', though no intense counter-press.

mar.personaBrief: Defence based on positioning rather than physical prowess; no explicit marking evidence, inferred as space-based with Zubizarreta deciding set pieces.

pla.personaBrief: Imposed one model at Barcelona, sold 15 players, 'we base ours on attack' against Milan; same idea regardless of opponent, one model from academy up.

res.personaBrief: 'I much prefer to win 5-4 than 1-0', defensive thinking didn't enter his mind, sends on another attacker; attacking football is the point, while still winning trophies.

sis.personaBrief: A system with defined roles and players who understand it; Guardiola 'intelligent with the ball'; stars like Stoichkov still had to fit, conflict model, but one idea for all.

jog.personaBrief: Technique took precedence over physical condition, short players with good touch, Guardiola as technician not runner, players need not run much but be positioned.

bas.personaBrief: Restructured La Masia youth system, 'good enough is old enough', Guardiola given to play; one model from youth up, though he also signed Laudrup, Koeman, Stoichkov.

lid.personaBrief: Cruyff was the boss, sold mutineers, closed the book on Stoichkov, conflict model rather than harmony; but kept the captain who spoke up and mixed personally with youth.
